## Validation

- [ ] `node scripts/validate-marketplace.mjs`
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-marketplace.mjs --verify-upstreams` (external plugins)
- [ ] Tested with a current Clarvis build
- [ ] Setup, environment variables, commands, network access, and trust-relevant behavior are documented
- [ ] No credentials, generated dependency trees, vendored secrets, or unexplained binaries are included
- [ ] The bundled contribution is MIT-licensed here, or the external listing retains a clear
      upstream license
